title: RNAqueous with No DNAse, DNA Removal by Acid Phenol:Chloroform
author: Dan Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.itbcein
materials: On ice, add more lysis buffer undetermined

steps.title: Prepare Elution Solution
steps.instruction: Place elution solution in a dry bath at 70-80ºC.

steps.title: Resuspend and Lyse Pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in lysis buffer and ensure complete lysis.

substeps.instruction: Place pellet in a 50 mL conical tube on ice.
Add lysis buffer.
Pipette up and down 5 times to resuspend pellet.
Pipette up and down 20 times to fully resuspend/lyse pellet.
Transfer the mixture into two 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes on ice.

steps.title: Verify Lysis
steps.instruction: Check for complete cell lysis using a microscope.

substeps.instruction: Take an aliquot from one Eppendorf tube and pipette onto a glass slide; keep the slide inside a petri dish to contain the noxious smell.
Immediately centrifuge both tubes at max speed in a microcentrifuge at 1ºC for 5 min to pellet unlysed bacteria.
During centrifugation, add a cover slip to the glass slide and confirm lysis using a microscope.

steps.title: Process Lysate
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysate for filtration based on lysis results.

substeps.instruction: If cells were lysed, transfer supernatant into two new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes; otherwise, continue with the same tubes.
On ice, pass the lysate in each tube 5 times through a 25 gauge needle fitted to an RNAse-free 1 mL syringe.
If cells were not lysed, pass through the needle additional times and re-check lysis before continuing.

steps.title: Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Filter the lysate/ethanol mixture using a filter cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Add 64% EtOH at room temperature (RT) to each tube.
Mix thoroughly by inverting the tubes several times.
Transfer lysate/ethanol mixture from one of the Eppendorf tubes to a single filter cartridge in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec or until the mixture is drawn through the filter.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation process three additional times until all lysate/ethanol mixture from both tubes has been drawn through the filter.

steps.title: Wash Filter Cartridge
steps.instruction: Wash the filter cartridge to remove impurities.

substeps.instruction: Add wash solution #1 and centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec.
Add wash solution #2/3 and centrifuge at 15,000 xg, RT, for 30 sec.
Repeat the wash solution #2/3 and centrifugation step.
Centrifuge an additional 30 sec at 15,000 x g to remove residual wash solution #2/3.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the RNA from the filter cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Place filter cartridge in a new collection tube.
Pipette pre-heated elution solution onto the filter and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 sec.
Pipette additional pre-heated elution solution onto the filter and centrifuge at 15,000 x g for 30 sec.
Ensure the final volume of eluate is ~45 uL.

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute RNA
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and prepare dilutions for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Spec on NanoDrop.
Make a 1:5 dilution (2 µl : 8 µl) in a separate tube for PCR/Bioanalyzer.
Take an aliquot of the 1:5 dilution and dilute to 1 ng/µL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: DNA Removal by Acid Phenol:Chloroform
steps.instruction: Perform sequential extractions to remove DNA and proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add water to bring volume to 400 µL.
Add 3 M sodium acetate at pH = 5.2 (1/10 volume) to a final concentration of 0.3 M.
Add 2 volumes of acid phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol at pH = 4.5.
Shake vigorously inside the fume hood for 15 sec.
Centrifuge at max speed in a microcentrifuge at 4ºC for 2 min (check for insoluble precipitate indicating potassium salts > 20 mM).
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new tube.
Repeat the acid phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (pH 4.5, 2 volumes) extraction, shaking (15 sec), and centrifugation (4ºC, 2 min) two more times, transferring the aqueous phase each time.

steps.title: Final Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a final chloroform extraction and RNA precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol.
Shake vigorously inside fume hood for 15 sec.
Centrifuge at max speed in a microcentrifuge at 4ºC for 2 min.
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add GlycoBlue (final amount ~25 µg, working stock 15 µg/µL).
Add 2.5 volumes of 100% EtOH and shake vigorously to mix.
Centrifuge at max speed in a microcentrifuge for 10 min at 4ºC.
Decant ethanol and remove residual with a pipette.
Wash with -20ºC 70% ethanol and centrifuge for 5 min at 4ºC.
Dry the pellet and resuspend in water.

steps.title: Final Quantification
steps.instruction: Perform final RNA quantification and dilution.

substeps.instruction: Spec on NanoDrop.
Dilute RNA to 1 ng/µL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer.
